limits: The local h2 no-lateral response is supported. A blanket claim that transfers never use lateral is contradicted as a net-source claim: later ordinary lateral supply feeds the transfer BO and OUTs the peer's item.

One IID, one h2 OUT from empty local stock, one stocked peer, IMMEDIATE/DLAYL=N, one seed/CLI. No universal priority, all transfer types, other timing, GUI-visual or cross-engine inference.
